lookup_entry_and_request.contract: Registers balanceCode_1..5 and realId+_userAggregate_multiCode. Legacy onPopup/onAutoComplete dispatch sumCondition_multiCode, sumCondition_summaryCondition_multiCode or realId+_userAggregate_multiCode to _setMultiCode. Specific current popup DOM/checkbox callback binding is external. If settingInfo.setOptions.isNewType is truthy, cmbSumFlagDate takes _setCondition instead; current value unknown.

If aggregateInfo.condition===true, serialize condition control by ID and take value whose key exactly sumCondition_multiCode. Otherwise read serialized searchForm.REPORT_TARGET, fallback empty string. This reads the selected-ID transport field; it does not resolve metric names/formulas.

Split selected string on |, skip empty segments, preserve remaining string order; each becomes {Index:0..,Seq:segment,Selected:true}. Mutate lookup request with FORM_TYPE=pageInfo.formType.output, IS_TARGET=true, IS_CONDITION=false, REPORT_LIST=list, IsUsingGroupColCd=true, preserving PARAM. No dedup/name/metric resolution is implemented in this function.

For rbReportType_summaryCondition_multiCode, read REPORT_TYPE_summaryCondition_multiCode and send REPORT_SEQ=t.toString() plus output FORM_TYPE/IS_TARGET=true/IS_CONDITION=false. Do not merge this REPORT_SEQ variant with REPORT_LIST without the current control binding.

Axis control lookup sends CONTROL_INDEX, existing/current condition Seq list, IS_CONDITION=true and IS_TARGET=false. This is separate from numeric target selection; target transport is not evidence that targets alter grouping identity.
